tasks.title: Move bake-off into its own folder, separate from the real project
tasks.notes: Goal: one distinct top-level folder in the main repo (e.g. bakeoff/) holding everything bake-off, so it cannot be mixed up with real world/tool work. Today it is scattered: model-bakeoffs/ (PROTOCOL, README, catalogue, config, packs, rounds, checks), scripts/model_bakeoff.py + test_model_bakeoff.py + feature_selection_check.py, skill .claude/skills/model-bakeoff, docs/model-bakeoffs.md, and the world checkout worlds/bakeoff (gitignored, own git repo). References to update: AGENTS.md, docs/active-world-contract.md, docs/audits/region-block-reads.md, rules/build-roles.md, scripts/run_tests.py, scripts/stale_terms_audit.py, tasks/done.json notes, the round JSONs (R-006..R-013), checks/feature-selection scenarios, and the 'refuse unless active world is bakeoff' guards in model_bakeoff.py. Open decisions: (1) does the bakeoff world checkout also move into the new folder or stay under worlds/ (active_world.py / AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT expectations); (2) shared code (feature_build, site_kit, world_frame) stays in scripts/ and is imported, not copied. #95 symptom (bakeoff missing OSM clips / cross-world osm_root) fixed by on-disk copy 2026-10-25 — this ticket no longer absorbs that; OSM-as-normal-reference architecture is #97. Do not move mid-sitting: finish or park R-014 first. Ship via task/* branch.

tasks.title: Treat OSM vector_map as a normal download/cache reference
tasks.notes: Architectural cause behind #95 (symptom fixed by copying clips into bakeoff). Desired end state: OSM / vector_map clips go through the same download → cache → project reference story as other evidence — not a bolted-on parallel loader. Once per project (shared across cells); rare or once-off use still hits the same cached reference. Today: imagery uses references_for_cell / manifest; OSM uses separate vector_map_clip_root / OSMIndex; Geofabrik (geofabrik-hampshire) is often checklist: false so cells do not pull clips the way they pull aerial. Desired: unify so OSM is downloaded/cached like other references; getter/guide paths treat it as a normal project-level reference under reference/vector_map (no cross-world osm_root=, no live symlink into another checkout as the primary story). Related: #95 closed as symptom copy; #96 is the bake-off folder move (do not start mid R-014) and is not the OSM unify. Do not reopen #93/#94. Implement on task/* when picked up — this ticket records the cause work, not a silent big unify in the #95 pass.
